column1: # shell-lint baseline — file<TAB>ShellCheck code<TAB>count, regenerated by
# "bin/shell-lint.sh --update-baseline". Hand edits are pointless: the next run of that
# command overwrites them. WHAT THIS IS: a debt ledger of findings that existed when the
# lane landed, so the lane starts green and reds on the NEXT one. Nothing here has been
# judged correct. Read the header of bin/shell-lint.sh for why it is keyed by count and
# not by line, and for what a FALLING count does and does not prove.
# THE "#pop" LINES ARE THE POPULATION this ledger was measured over, and they are CHECKED:
# bin/shell-lint.sh re-derives the population on every run and refuses to report on a tree
# that has lost one of them. A file leaving coverage drives its counts down exactly as a fix
# does, and this list is the only record that tells the two apart.
